about: Global consumer brands with the capacity to reinvest.

sold.name: Eaton Vance Sr Income Tr    Sf

summary: Concentrated: 84 holdings, but the top ten are 80% of the portfolio.
Trades moderately: about 16% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for at least 9.7 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are similarly priced, more profitable and faster-growing.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 3 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Born in 1955; Dartmouth, then law and business degrees from Stanford. Worked on the Sequoia Fund at Ruane, Cunniff & Goldfarb, and joined Gardner Investments (now Gardner Russo & Quinn) in 1989, where he runs the Semper Vic partnership.
profile.approach: Global food, drink, tobacco and media brands, often family-controlled, run by managers willing to accept short-term costs for long-term growth.
known: Semper Vic returned more than 12% a year from 1990 to 2016, against about 9% for the S&P 500.
Bought Weetabix in 1989 at under £6 a share; it was sold to private equity in 2003 for £54.
profile.note: Much of the portfolio is in non-US shares, which the 13F does not include.

name: Tom Russo
